target.title: fix: avoid false stayed-stopped on launchd KeepAlive throttle
target.body:
Closes #109941

## What Problem This Solves

Fixes an issue where operators running `openclaw gateway restart` on macOS would see a definitive false failure (`service stayed stopped and health checks never came up`) while a LaunchAgent-supervised gateway with `KeepAlive` was still inside launchd's normal `ThrottleInterval` respawn window and would become healthy seconds later. Automation that trusted that verdict could escalate against a recovering service.

## Why This Change Was Made

Restart health now prepares launchd KeepAlive supervision facts once before the poll loop and extends the continuous stopped-and-port-free early-exit threshold past the product `ThrottleInterval` when a loaded LaunchAgent is present. Unloaded, unmanaged, non-macOS, and non-KeepAlive paths keep the baseline fast-fail threshold. No new config knobs; supervisor facts are not rediscovered on every poll.

Compatibility: no config/API change; optional prepared `supervisor` param only. Performance: one `isLoaded` prepare at wait start. Usability: false failure verdict avoided during normal KeepAlive recovery. Security: no auth/trust change.

## User Impact

On macOS managed LaunchAgent installs, `openclaw gateway restart` no longer reports a hard "stayed stopped" failure solely because launchd is throttling a KeepAlive respawn. Genuine permanent stop / unload still fails within the existing overall restart health budget.

## Evidence

Verification host: local macOS (Crabbox bypass)

```text
$ node scripts/run-vitest.mjs src/cli/daemon-cli/restart-health-wait.test.ts
 ✓ |cli| src/cli/daemon-cli/restart-health-wait.test.ts (16 tests) 666ms
 Test Files  1 passed (1)
      Tests  16 passed (16)

$ node scripts/run-vitest.mjs src/cli/daemon-cli/restart-health.test.ts src/cli/daemon-cli/lifecycle.test.ts
 ✓ |cli| src/cli/daemon-cli/restart-health.test.ts (27 tests)
 ✓ |cli| src/cli/daemon-cli/lifecycle.test.ts (34 tests)
 Test Files  2 passed (2)
      Tests  61 passed (61)

$ pnpm check:changed
[check:changed] lanes=core, coreTests
… typecheck core / core tests / lint on touched files …
check:changed exit=0
```

Key new cases:

- KeepAlive + ThrottleInterval=10s early-exits only after ~20s continuous stopped+free (not the previous ~12.5s baseline false window)
- KeepAlive recovery that binds after the old 12.5s window returns `healthy` instead of `stopped-free`
- Unloaded / non-KeepAlive still uses the baseline ~12.5s early exit

## Real behavior proof

Verification host: local macOS with an isolated real LaunchAgent. The active `ai.openclaw.gateway` service was not touched.

The proof used the production LaunchAgent installer, service adapter, port inspection, and `waitForGatewayHealthyRestart` path with a random temporary label, HOME, and port. The supervised child deliberately exited on launches 1 and 2, then bound its port on launch 3. Cleanup booted out the temporary job and removed its files.

```json
{
  "proof": "isolated-real-launchd-keepalive",
  "label": "<isolated-label>",
  "keepAlive": true,
  "throttleIntervalSeconds": 10,
  "attemptsObserved": 3,
  "respawnGapsMs": [10113, 10113],
  "waitOutcome": "healthy",
  "healthy": true,
  "runtimeStatus": "running",
  "portStatus": "busy",
  "elapsedMs": 20667.57,
  "exceededOldStoppedFreeWindow": true
}
```

This exercises real launchd KeepAlive/throttle cadence: recovery occurred after the old ~12.5s stopped-free verdict window, and the patched wait returned healthy. During proof hardening, the threshold was also corrected to sample one full poll after the throttle boundary (20.5s at 500ms), rather than exactly on it.

Focused validation after the proof hardening:

```text
$ node scripts/run-vitest.mjs src/cli/daemon-cli/restart-health-wait.test.ts src/cli/daemon-cli/restart-health.test.ts src/cli/daemon-cli/lifecycle.test.ts
Test Files  3 passed (3)
Tests       77 passed (77)
```
